items.title: At least 31 dead after Russia drops nine bombs on a Ukrainian school building
items.brief: Dozens of people were killed when Russia dropped at least nine bombs on a school building in southeastern Ukraine where they had taken shelter.

items.title: Spanish soccer player Jesús de Miguel dies after on-pitch collision
items.brief: Soccer player Jesús de Miguel has died after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match on Monday, his club CD Tenerife has said.

items.title: US military conducts strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island in defensive operation, officials say
items.brief: The US military carried out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island on Monday, three US officials told CNN, characterizing the action as defensive in nature and meant to protect US assets in the region.
